title: Netting required.
officialText:
Where it is possible for the public to pass under, or next to, platforms, the space between the top rail
and the toeboard shall be enclosed with a wire screen composed of not less than No. 18 steel wire gage, or equivalent synthetic
netting that is flame retardant in accordance with NPFA 701, with openings in the wire or synthetic mesh no larger than ½ inch
(13 mm).
